description.it: Vita di frate Egidio d’Assisi, terzo compagno di san Francesco, in dieci capitoli.
description.en-US: The Life of Brother Giles of Assisi, the third companion of St. Francis, in ten chapters. Italian, with the Hudleston revision of the first English translation beside it.
description.pt-BR: A Vida de frei Egídio de Assis, terceiro companheiro de São Francisco, em dez capítulos.

it.editor: transcription by M. Mastrorilli, Politecnico di Bari; edition not stated

en-US.translator: first English translation (Lady Georgiana Fullerton, 1864), revised by Dom Roger Hudleston

sources.edition: Vita di frate Egidio, poliba.it (Wayback Machine snapshot).
sources.description: Ten chapters. The English of the CCEL Hudleston revision (Part III) is not imported.
sources.tierEvidence: Medieval text. The transcription (M. Mastrorilli, Politecnico di Bari, Biblioteca di Scienze del Cristianesimo, 2000-02) survives only in the Wayback Machine; it states no edition, but its biblical apparatus follows Fontes Franciscani (1995). Free in practice, edition unverified.

sources.edition: The Little Flowers of St. Francis, first English translation revised and emended by Dom Roger Hudleston (London: Burns Oates, 1926), Christian Classics Ethereal Library, flowers.txt.
sources.description: The corresponding part of the CCEL text, one chapter to a chapter of the Italian, with the chapter headings as titles. The Heritage Press introduction by Arthur Livingston (1965) is not imported.
sources.tierEvidence: Translation of 1864, revision of 1926 (Hudleston d. 1925); CCEL marks it public domain.

title.en-US: Chapter I: How brother giles, with three companions was received into the order of friar's minor
Chapter II: How brother giles went to st james the great
Chapter III: Of brother giles's manner of life when he went to the holy sepulchre
Chapter IV: How brother giles praised obedience more than prayer
Chapter V: How brother giles lived by the labour of his hands
Chapter VI: How brother giles was miraculously assisted in a great necessity when, by reason of a heavy fall of snow, he was hindered from going out to quest.
Chapter VII: Of the day of the holy brother giles's death
Chapter VIII: How a holy man, being in prayer, saw the soul of brother giles pass to eternal life
Chapter IX: How, by the merits of brother giles, the soul of the friend of a friar preacher was delivered from the pains of purgatory
Chapter X: How god gave special graces to brother giles, and of the year of his death
